# Security Checklist: Desktop Cabinet Embedding

**Purpose**: Validate security, privacy, and evidence requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are allowed embedded routes explicitly enumerated and limited to meeting list/detail surfaces? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, Route Contract]
- [x] CHK002 Are forbidden capture, device, permission, local file, local purge, diagnostics, share, export, download, and deletion routes explicitly excluded? [Completeness, Spec FR-004/FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are server offline, timeout, expired-session, denied, not-found, and malformed-response states required to avoid foreign content disclosure? [Coverage, Spec US3, FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are forbidden secret/content classes listed for UI, logs, diagnostics, accessibility labels, evidence, and screenshots? [Completeness, Spec FR-008, SC-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are hard-coded secrets, private account identifiers, and private reference screenshots excluded from development validation? [Completeness, Clarifications, Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK006 Are route policy requirements consistent with the native shell rule that recording and local diagnostics cannot execute from embedded web content? [Consistency, Route Contract, Native Shell Contract]
- [x] CHK007 Are upload review links required to use server meeting identity rather than signed URLs or live local paths? [Consistency, Data Model UploadReviewLink]
- [x] CHK008 Are access-denied and not-found requirements consistent with prior RLS/privacy-preserving denial behavior? [Consistency, Spec US3, 016 route boundary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK009 Can no-secret/no-content evidence be objectively evaluated through scans of UI strings, diagnostics, screenshots, and tracked evidence? [Measurability, Spec SC-005]
- [x] CHK010 Can route allow/deny behavior be tested without live private accounts or destructive server mutations? [Measurability, Validation Contract]
- [x] CHK011 Are external links required to be blocked by default unless classified as safe, non-mutating, and external? [Clarity, Route Contract]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK012 Are dependencies on existing auth/session context documented without implementing new auth storage in this slice? [Dependency, Research, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Is the absence of public sharing/export/delete execution consistent with future `017` and `018` separation? [Dependency, Spec Out of scope]
